description: This file contains unit tests for the HpackVarintDecoder class, testing varint encoding/decoding in HTTP/2 HPACK header compression, including encoding validation, range testing, and specific value tests.

classes.name: HpackVarintRoundTripTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing HPACK varint encoding/decoding, inheriting from RandomDecoderTest, with methods for encoding, decoding, and validation of varint data.

methods.name: HiValueOfExtensionBytes
methods.description: Calculates the highest value with a given number of extension bytes and prefix length.

methods.name: StartDecoding
methods.description: Initializes decoding with a prefix byte from the buffer.

methods.name: ResumeDecoding
methods.description: Resumes decoding from the current buffer position.

methods.name: DecodeSeveralWays
methods.description: Validates decoding correctness across different segmentations of input data.

methods.name: EncodeNoRandom
methods.description: Encodes a value into varint format without adding randomness.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a value into varint format with added random bits in the prefix.

methods.name: ValidateEncoding
methods.description: Checks that the encoded buffer matches expected encoding parameters.

methods.name: EncodeAndDecodeValues
methods.description: Encodes a set of values, then decodes and validates each.

methods.name: EncodeAndDecodeValuesInRange
methods.description: Encodes a range of values, then decodes and validates them.
